channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Pakistan’s army chief in Iran as US’s Rubio says ‘slight progress’ in talks
item.description: Pakistan’s Asim Munir is in Tehran as part of mediation efforts, as EU moves to sanction Iran over the Hormuz blockade.

item.title: Displaced Lebanese amputee asks ‘where am I supposed to go’?
item.description: Mohamad Saaydoun, an amputee displaced by the latest Israel-Hezbollah war, is living in a makeshift camp.

item.title: ‘I always hear them before I see them’: Drones strike fear in Colombia
item.description: Armed groups have taken the conflict to the skies by making greater use of cheap, widely available drone technology.

item.title: Video shows Israeli strike on Lebanese child and paramedics
item.description: Video shows an Israeli air strike hitting paramedics responding to an earlier attack in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Economic confidence plummets in US amid Iran war, poll shows
item.description: As petrol prices rise, new survey suggests economic confidence in the US is at -45, the worst since 2022.

item.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
item.description: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

item.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran publishes a map claiming "armed forces oversight" across more than 22,000 sq km of the waterway.
